posts.title: Oh right I should write
posts.description: I bought a bear subscription around a year ago. I was in a bar in Lausanne, waiting for my girlfriend while topped with 2 beers. The bar was cosy and nice, low lights, made me want to do something interesting. I dove into my positive melancholic moods. They are sad for they sing about what could be, but happy, because the song reminds me of the possibility. I leant into the possible, fortunately.

posts.title: Whom bells toll for
posts.description: My village bells toll for something. Not me, I think. The houses are a bit brighter, the roofs cleaner. I have been away for some time. Why do I drink at the cafe while my father is buried? Is it an honor to how he lived, or an honor I do to myself? Will the bells toll for me

posts.title: christmas dinner
posts.description: She is shaking. The chimney. With a weight of a women that never leant. Will it hold to everything that was and never came to be, or burn like so many before? My siblings cry over a spoiled Christmas dinner. Mine is salty from the dessert. As we go home no one dares to talk. We ate too much
